info.name: NFC Card Platform API
info.description: Postman collection for NFC Digital Card Platform API endpoints. Fully updated with System, Authentication & Account Recovery, Card Types (Admin), Card Generation & Batch Operations (Admin - F-005), Card Inventory & Lifecycle (Admin - F-006), Card Replacement Requests (Admin - F-015), Cards & Customer Lifecycle (F-007 & F-015), Profile & Public SSR (F-008, F-010, F-013, F-015), Templates (F-009), Analytics & Telemetry (F-014), and Admin Operations & Analytics (F-012).

Filter by status: PENDING | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | CANCELLED

request.description: Admin lists and paginates all customer card replacement requests.
Admin updates replacement request status (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED).

variable.description: Batch UUID to invalidate (deactivates AVAILABLE cards only)

request.description: Customer reports active card as lost, damaged, or stolen. Sets card status to PAUSED and logs a replacement request.
Customer requests a new replacement card. Leaves current card in its status and creates a PENDING replacement request for admin processing.
Retrieve all replacement requests submitted by the authenticated customer.

item.name: Download Contact vCard by Card Token (Public - F-013)

request.description: Public direct card endpoint to download a .vcf contact file generated from the cardholder's public fields.

item.name: Profile & Public SSR (F-008, F-010, F-013, F-015)

request.description: POST alias to create or update authenticated user's card profile.
Customer instantly pauses their ACTIVE card. The public profile returns 404/unavailable immediately.
Customer resumes their PAUSED card back to ACTIVE status. Public profile is immediately restored.
Retrieve performance analytics for the authenticated customer's card (views today, 7d, 30d, all-time, link clicks).
Public endpoint to download a .vcf contact card from the public profile path.
Download contact vCard (.vcf) via the primary public shortlink route (/p/:type/:token/contact.vcf).
Public ingestion endpoint to log card views and contact link clicks with bot filtering and 30-min deduplication.
